parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State or imply $6xy+3x^2\dfrac{dy}{dx}$ as the derivative of $3x^2y$. B1. State or imply $3y^2\dfrac{dy}{dx}$ as the derivative of $y^3$. B1; allow the printed differential form. Equate the attempted derivative of the left side to zero and solve to make $dy/dx$ the subject. M1; allow zero to be implied and recovery from an extra $dy/dx$ at the start. Obtain $\dfrac{dy}{dx}=\dfrac{x^2+2xy}{y^2-x^2}$ correctly. A1 AG; accept $y'$ for $dy/dx$. Total 4.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Equate the numerator of the given derivative to zero. M1; must use the given derivative. Obtain $x=-2y$, or equivalent. A1; an equation with $x$ or $y$ as subject SOI. Use $x^3+3x^2y-y^3=3$ to obtain an equation in $x$ or $y$. DM1; printed examples include $-8y^3+12y^3-y^3=3$. Obtain $(-2,1)$ and no other point from solving the cubic. A1; components may be stated separately; ISW. State $(0,-\sqrt[3]{3})$, equivalently $(0,\sqrt[3]{-3})$ or $(0,-1.44)$, from correct work. B1; components may be stated separately; ISW. Total 5.
